name: Goodwill Career Solutions
description: Free job training, resume help, and employment placement for people with barriers to employment.

pathwaySteps.title: Call or walk in for intake
pathwaySteps.detail: No appointment needed — walk in Mon–Fri 9am–5pm or call 412-632-2400

pathwaySteps.title: Complete skills assessment
pathwaySteps.detail: A career coach will assess your skills and identify training options — takes about 1 hour

pathwaySteps.title: Enroll in training program
pathwaySteps.detail: Choose from retail, warehouse, healthcare aide, or customer service tracks — all free

name: PA State Board of Nursing — License Reinstatement
description: Official process to reinstate a lapsed or revoked nursing license in Pennsylvania.

pathwaySteps.title: Get your criminal record report
pathwaySteps.detail: Request via Pennsylvania Access to Criminal History (PATCH) at epatch.pa.gov — free, takes 3 days

pathwaySteps.title: Complete reinstatement application
pathwaySteps.detail: Download form BPOA-NUR-RN-REINST from dos.pa.gov — include all conviction disclosures and a personal statement

pathwaySteps.title: Submit with fee and supporting docs
pathwaySteps.detail: Mail application + $100 fee + criminal record + personal statement. Board reviews in 60–90 days.

name: UPMC Western Psychiatric Hospital — PCSI Program
description: Outpatient addiction and mental health services for adults, including specialized re-entry support.

pathwaySteps.title: Call for a phone screening
pathwaySteps.detail: Call 412-624-2100 and ask for outpatient intake — screening takes 20 minutes

pathwaySteps.title: Attend intake appointment
pathwaySteps.detail: Bring ID and insurance card (Medicaid accepted). Intake appointment is about 90 minutes.

pathwaySteps.title: Begin individualized treatment plan
pathwaySteps.detail: Meet weekly with counselor; group sessions available. Medications (MAT) offered if appropriate.

name: Alma Illery Medical Center
description: Community health center offering primary care and behavioral health for underserved populations in Pittsburgh.

pathwaySteps.title: Call to schedule a new patient appointment
pathwaySteps.detail: Call 412-441-8272. Sliding scale fees based on income — Medicaid and uninsured patients welcome.

pathwaySteps.title: Bring ID and income documentation
pathwaySteps.detail: Any government ID works. For sliding scale: bring a recent pay stub or benefit letter.

pathwaySteps.title: Complete your health assessment
pathwaySteps.detail: First visit includes physical and behavioral health screening. Ongoing care coordinated from one location.

name: Allegheny County Legal Aid
description: Free civil legal help for low-income Allegheny County residents including family law, housing, and record expungement.

pathwaySteps.title: Call the intake line
pathwaySteps.detail: Call 412-255-6700 to determine if you qualify (income-based). Intake staff will explain next steps.

pathwaySteps.title: Gather relevant documents
pathwaySteps.detail: Court orders, custody paperwork, lease agreements, or any official notices related to your legal issue.

pathwaySteps.title: Meet with your assigned attorney
pathwaySteps.detail: All services are free for qualifying clients. Cases include expungement, custody, housing, and benefits.

name: Amachi Pittsburgh
description: Mentoring program connecting children of incarcerated parents with caring adult volunteers.

pathwaySteps.title: Call to enroll your child
pathwaySteps.detail: Call 412-361-5065. Children ages 6–17 with a parent who is or has been incarcerated are eligible.

pathwaySteps.title: Complete family intake
pathwaySteps.detail: A caseworker meets with you and your child to understand needs and preferences for a mentor match.

pathwaySteps.title: Begin mentoring relationship
pathwaySteps.detail: Mentor and child meet 2–4 times per month. Family support specialist checks in monthly.

name: ACTION-Housing Transitional Housing Program
description: Transitional and permanent supportive housing for women leaving incarceration in Allegheny County.

pathwaySteps.title: Submit a housing application
pathwaySteps.detail: Download the application at actionhousing.org or call 412-765-3810. Applications are rolling.

pathwaySteps.title: Complete eligibility interview
pathwaySteps.detail: A case manager will contact you within 5 business days to review income, history, and housing needs.

pathwaySteps.title: Move into transitional unit
pathwaySteps.detail: Stay up to 24 months with on-site support services. Goal is permanent housing placement.

name: Dollar Bank Financial Education Center
description: Free financial literacy workshops, credit counseling, and banking access for underserved communities.

pathwaySteps.title: Attend a free financial literacy workshop
pathwaySteps.detail: Workshops cover budgeting, saving, and avoiding predatory lenders. Register at dollarbank.com or call.

pathwaySteps.title: Schedule one-on-one credit counseling
pathwaySteps.detail: Free 60-minute session with a certified counselor to review your credit report and build a repair plan.

pathwaySteps.title: Open a second-chance checking account
pathwaySteps.detail: Dollar Bank's Fresh Start account is available even with past banking problems (ChexSystems).

name: Community College of Allegheny County (CCAC)
description: Affordable associate degrees, certificate programs, and GED preparation at multiple Pittsburgh campuses.

pathwaySteps.title: Attend an information session
pathwaySteps.detail: Free sessions held weekly at all CCAC campuses — no appointment needed. Find schedule at ccac.edu.

pathwaySteps.title: Apply and complete placement test
pathwaySteps.detail: Application is free online. Placement test determines which math and English courses to start in.

pathwaySteps.title: Apply for PELL grant and FAFSA
pathwaySteps.detail: Most re-entry students with drug convictions are now eligible. Financial aid office can help you apply.

name: CCAC Allied Health & Nursing Programs
description: CNA, LPN, and RN degree pathways at Allegheny Campus — affordable tuition with financial aid for qualifying students.

pathwaySteps.title: Attend an Allied Health info session
pathwaySteps.detail: Free sessions held monthly — covers CNA, LPN, and RN tracks, admission requirements, and costs. Register at ccac.edu.

pathwaySteps.title: Complete prerequisites and background check
pathwaySteps.detail: Most nursing programs require a PA background check (Act 34 + Act 73) and basic math/English placement. Advisors can help.

pathwaySteps.title: Apply for PELL grant and CareerLink funding
pathwaySteps.detail: Many re-entry students qualify for Pell grants. PA CareerLink can cover remaining tuition for healthcare tracks.

name: PA CareerLink Pittsburgh — Healthcare Training Fund
description: Funding and coaching for low-income adults pursuing healthcare careers including CNA, LPN, and phlebotomy training.

contact.address: 111 Blvd of the Allies, Pittsburgh PA 15222

pathwaySteps.title: Register at PA CareerLink Pittsburgh
pathwaySteps.detail: Walk in or call 412-325-3800. Create a free account at pacareerlink.pa.gov to access funding programs.

pathwaySteps.title: Meet with a healthcare career advisor
pathwaySteps.detail: Advisors identify training funds (WIOA, Pell) that can cover nursing school tuition and fees at approved programs.

pathwaySteps.title: Enroll in an approved nursing program
pathwaySteps.detail: CareerLink covers tuition at CCAC, Pittsburgh Technical, and other approved healthcare schools — can include books and supplies.

name: Goodwill SWPA — Healthcare Aide Training
description: Free 4-week Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) training program with job placement support upon completion.

pathwaySteps.title: Apply for the CNA training cohort
pathwaySteps.detail: Call 412-632-2400 or walk in. Cohorts start every 6 weeks — training is free including scrubs and textbooks.

pathwaySteps.title: Complete 4-week classroom and clinical training
pathwaySteps.detail: 75 hours total — 16 hours of clinical at a local nursing facility. Transportation assistance available.

pathwaySteps.title: Pass state CNA exam and get placed
pathwaySteps.detail: Goodwill pays for your state exam. Job placement coaches connect graduates with local hospitals and nursing homes.

name: Bethlehem Haven
description: Comprehensive services for homeless women including shelter, peer support, mental health, and job training.

pathwaySteps.title: Call or walk in for emergency shelter
pathwaySteps.detail: Open 24/7 for women needing immediate shelter. Bring ID if you have it — not required for emergency.

pathwaySteps.title: Meet with a case manager
pathwaySteps.detail: Within 72 hours of arrival a case manager creates a personalized plan covering housing, health, and employment goals.

pathwaySteps.title: Connect with peer support group
pathwaySteps.detail: Weekly peer groups for women with shared experiences — re-entry, addiction recovery, family reunification.
